topics.who: Oregon Pain Management Commission module; also due at initial licensure

rules.notes: No general CE hours until Jan 1, 2028; only the pain-management and cultural-competency courses (cultural competency: any provider, OHA lists suggested courses). Practice hours dropped Jan 1, 2026. From Jan 1, 2028: 20 hours of CE every two years.
rules.rule_quote: Beginning January 1, 2028, the following will also be required for renewal: LPN and RN applicants will need to provide evidence of 20 hours of continuing education.
